scope.decision: Private release recorded by parent; public-release approval pending. Static evidence, not legal approval.
scope.artifact_location: Parent-supplied dist/verified-windows-0.2.1; only the six top-level archives and SHA256SUMS.txt were inspected.
scope.excluded: No compilers, Cargo metadata, dependency scripts, native execution, installs, archive extraction, network/remote verification, clean-host/audio tests, music/index access, privacy/history scan or publication actions.
scope.historical_evidence: windows-selected-dependencies.json is retained x86_64-pc-windows-msvc evidence, not a newly resolved x86 graph. Prior multi-platform/native-preview records were not replayed.

method: Python standard-library pathlib/hashlib/json/tomllib/zipfile/tarfile/struct/re/stat only for artifact and inventory checks; repository scripts read as text, never imported or executed.
SHA-256 raw archive bytes compared with SHA256SUMS.txt and parent verification size/hash fields. Parent inputs hashed separately.

ZIP and gzip-tar regular members read in memory; duplicate/unsafe names and members >=32 MiB rejected. Complete member sets, hashes and permission modes compared with embedded payload/source inventories, excluding generated BUILD-PROVENANCE.json from those inventories.

BUILD-PROVENANCE.json compared byte-for-byte across binary/app/Olaf archives per target; parsed JSON compared with parent manifest, commit and target. source_inventory_sha256 recomputed using JSON sorted keys, indent=2 and final LF.

Common app/Olaf source members, all licenses/ members and root LICENSE/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md compared byte-for-byte with binary packages. Source groups compared across targets except BUILD-PROVENANCE.json.

Runtime provenance, license, notice, BUILDING.md and ten notice files compared with source (Zigzag notice maps to vendor/zigzag/LICENSE). BUILD-INFO target, binary digest and LF-normalized source-provenance digest checked.

All 251 vendor provenance file hashes checked with CRLF-to-LF normalization; seven ordered series entries compared with provenance. Each 0006/0007 unified-diff new-side hunk checked at its declared line offset against archived patched source; no patch application or full-series replay.

Independent DOS/PE header, COFF machine, PE32/PE32+ and section-backed normal import (directory 1) / RVA delay-import (directory 13) descriptor parsing; DLL-name unions compared with parent/embedded records. No symbol/thunk audit, loader execution, dynamic LoadLibrary tracing or link-map reconstruction.

Cargo.lock parsed: 115 registry names/versions/checksums and LF lock hash compared with rust-inventory; 240 retained Rust notice hashes, 11 Olaf notice hashes/source copies and 20 source-records copy hashes/archive-checksum-to-lock associations checked. No crates re-fetched.

Target predicates, feature forwarding, SQLite build branches, release/provider scripts and Olaf subprocess/configuration paths read statically, not treated as resolved features or actual linked objects.
input_hash_note: WINDOWS_DISTRIBUTION.md is the pre-review baseline. All listed checkout inputs matched the inspected x86 source archive union before edits; x64 sources were equal except build provenance. Retained crate-copy hashes are enumerated in unchanged source-records.json.

parent_report_only.menu_exit: passed for both targets; no index created
parent_report_only.limits: Remote visibility/download identity, builds, gates and menu execution not repeated. Embedded/parent records say x64 native and x86 WOW64, 16 gates each; WOW64 is not native 32-bit Windows testing.

established_observations: Six archive sizes/hashes and all member sets/modes/hashes match supplied records. This establishes internal byte correspondence, not independent proof that binaries were compiled from those sources.

Each target has 315 payload files, 349 app-source files and 556 Olaf-source files, each archive plus build provenance. Source inventories are identical across architectures; only generated build provenance differs.

297 legal/evidence members (295 under licenses/ plus root MIT and third-party notices) match all three archives per target. Ten runtime notices and runtime provenance/legal/build documentation match source. Binary ZIP differences are enumerated above.

Both source sets contain the seven ordered patches; all eight 0006 and five 0007 new-side hunks match source. README dates both changes 2026-11-01; changed DB/core/threading/UI sources carry that date. Native behavior/full-series reconstruction not established.

0006 contains 32-bit 512 MiB mapping, full-width comparisons, alignment-safe reads, checked writes and regression source. 0007 contains the MinGW _X86_ C-import define and mutex-protected full-width counters, including UI.

Relevant Olaf/Zigzag manifests, source, configuration, scripts and attribution are present and match inventory. App source has Cargo.lock and evidence copies, not vendored registry implementations. Outside rust-app/, only the libsqlite3-sys/sqlite-wasm-rs review build scripts are .rs members; no Apple-family or sqlite-wasm-rs implementation bundle is present.

Cargo.lock has 115 registry packages plus app; historical selected list has 72 dependencies plus app. rfd wayland/xdg-portal and rusqlite ffi-sqlite-wasm-rs feature labels occur there despite excluded platform dependency paths.

Each binary ZIP has only the app and Olaf executables, with no bundled DLL/installer, FFmpeg/FFprobe, SDK or compiler executable. All four PE DLL descriptor sets match records; delay-import directories are empty. Apps import VCRUNTIME140/UCRT/Windows DLLs; Olaf imports UCRT/Windows DLLs. x64 Olaf additionally imports api-ms-win-crt-private-l1-1-0.dll.

Rust 1.99.0 COPYRIGHT-library.html plus 12 license texts, Zig 0.16.0 MIT, mingw-w64 COPYING and musl COPYRIGHT match across packages. Installed toolchains were not inspected. No licenses/toolchains directory exists.
static_inference: Both Windows MSVC targets satisfy rfd cfg(target_os = "windows") selecting windows-sys on that path (locked 0.61.2), not its macOS/Linux-BSD/wasm32 predicates. Six Apple-family direct dependencies and objc2 -> objc2-encode are excluded on that rfd path, not proved absent from every possible path.

Both fail rusqlite cfg(all(target_family = "wasm", target_os = "unknown")) and satisfy its negation selecting libsqlite3-sys (locked 0.39.1). Default ffi-sqlite-wasm-rs does not override the target predicate.

App bundled forwards to libsqlite3-sys bundled/modern bindings. Its build script includes SQLite C, MSVC/optional crt-static and environment/feature override branches. release.py strips relevant inherited overrides. These are recipes, not an x86 resolved feature graph or emitted-object proof.

Olaf native CLI recipe adds LMDB/PFFFT/c-algorithms, local Zigzag and REST and links libc for both architectures. Provider targets x86-windows-gnu versus x86_64-windows-gnu; this is not an exact linker inventory.

App integration generates index-local config, pins a copied runtime digest, invokes store/query with isolated HOME/USERPROFILE and external FFmpeg verification. This path does not start REST; retained REST/UI and future network deployment still require section 13 review.
